the open part; partition-refinement structures are the natural toolbox.

        rest.insert(1, v)

    if n >= 4 and pv != n - 4:

    n = len(graph)

        if _check_lb(old_ordering, graph):

            return state

    state = dict(state)
    state['ordering'] = ordering
    return state
